title: Eternal Ocean
description: An ocean world with creatable ships along with many new fishes and other creatures. Swimming and fishing are overhauled, along with plenty of new structures and biomes to explore.
body: This modpack was created for a ocean themed modded server. It focuses primarily on changing the height and depth of the ocean, adding new sea creatures and structures, and adding/reworking tons of ocean biomes. It features mods like Alex's Mobs to add stunning creatures, or other mods like Rolling Down in the Deep to add fully customized swimming. A huge focus is also the create mod, including aeronautics, which will allow you to build and customize your very own ship to sail the seas. Even with it being ocean themed, there are still islands scattered about with gorgeous landscapes. Pillager ships also roam the seas with plenty of booty to steal. The nether has also recieved a rework to its lava lakes with plenty of new fish and even a lava fishing system. This modpack is for those who love to adventure, and enjoy the beauty of things in life such as the oceans and seas. Or you can make a ship and scavenge everything like a true pirate!
